name: red-new-session-calendar-utc
note: G1 design §9, item 5 -- the other half of the acceptance pair. Byte-identical bars to red-new-session-calendar-ist.json, same source, only the instrument differs (CRYPTO resolves to a UTC calendar, offset 0). Under UTC: bars 0-4 are 07-26 (16:00 through 23:00 UTC) and bars 5-6 are 07-27 (01:00, 02:00 UTC), so the boundary sits after bar 4 rather than after bar 1. Both the spawn condition and the termination move with the calendar, which is the point: the same program over the same bars produces different geometry on a different instrument.
source:
indicator("H", shorttitle="H", overlay=true)
newday = na(dayofmonth[1]) or dayofmonth != dayofmonth[1]
plotlevel(newday, close, "SR", extend=extend.until, terminate=terminate.new_session)
